args.message:
Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The docstring already specified ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Update the quantize call and the
import so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66),
matching tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py.

## Problem
`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP` when quantizing to cents. Banker's rounding is required per FIN-212 so ties round to the nearest even cent.

## Fix
Use `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`:
- 2.675 -> 2.68 (unchanged; already rounds up under both modes)
- 2.665 -> 2.66 (now rounds to the even cent; previously 2.67 under HALF_UP)

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 on commit 40806e4668 passed, including tests/test_money.py::test_half_even.
